importantFindings: A low-confidence recognized DOB remains visible and marked “Lettura incerta”; when an independently read age corroborates it within the existing one-year rule, the row may be saved without an explicit confirmation. The retained DOB still determines persisted age and minor/adult status. This matches the established S3 behavior and is not a new S5 defect, but it remains a consequential accepted limitation near the 18-year boundary.
